title: 第五章 痛不欲生求我可怜他
slug: 恶毒雌性玩的花兽世大佬排队跪
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

话音戛然而止。

对方显然没料到，会看见这样一幕。

洞里，姜枝半跪在石床边，整个人几乎贴在苍凛怀里，手还绕在他肩背后头。

苍凛赤着上身，肩背结实，低头看着她，气氛安静得诡异。

门口那个雌性的眼珠子都快瞪出来了。

记忆涌入姜枝的脑子，面前的雌性叫青芽，未成年雌性，拥有众多保护者，都等着她成年和她结婚。其中就有原主爱得无法自拔的首领狮鹫。

原身与青芽交好，多半也是打着首领的主意。

青芽看了看姜枝，又看了看苍凛，再看了看床上那堆药草和麻布，表情逐渐变得像见了鬼。

“你、你在给苍凛上药？”

姜枝也僵住了。

不是，你们这地方进别人家门都不先敲门的吗？

哦，秒懂了。

她这洞根本就没有门，一草帘子而已，幸好之前别人没有一掀帘子就进来啊！

姜枝赶紧收回手，把麻布最后打了个结。她不想OOC地太突然，故意恶声恶气地对青芽说：“不，我在给苍凛涂毒药，等他伤口发炎溃烂，痛不欲生求我可怜他。”

善良年幼的青芽大为震惊，但一想到平时姜枝的所作所为又觉得合情合理。

唯一让她觉得不合理的事就是：

“首领那边……”

在她的认知里，姜枝对领袖的痴迷程度已经到了闻一下对方的气息，都能脸红三天的地步。

别说受伤，哪怕首领只是狩猎回来衣角破了一点，姜枝都得心疼得团团转。

现在她居然全然不顾首领……在屋里糟蹋苍凛？

姜枝见她那表情，索性破罐子破摔，摆出一副“少见多怪”的架势：“首领那边最近我不想去了。我要冷他几天，才能让他记得我的好！”

青芽很想说，冷几天，首领就忘记了你了！但看姜枝的表情，虽然未成年但情商很高的她决定闭嘴。

“青芽，你还有事吗？没事把帘子放下，风都灌进来了。”姜枝生怕自己多说多错，立刻就打算送客。

青芽欲言又止，最后只能机械地“哦”了一声，手忙脚乱把帘子放下，临走前还差点被门口的石头绊一跤。

等外头脚步声远了，姜枝终于松了口气。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The words stopped abruptly.

The other party obviously didn't expect to see such a scene.

In the cave, Jiang Zhi was half-kneeling beside the stone bed, almost leaning against Cang Lin's arms, with her hands still around his shoulders and behind his head.

Cang Lin was bare-chested, with strong shoulders, looking down at her, the atmosphere was strangely quiet.

The female at the door almost bulged her eyes out.

Memories flooded into Jiang Zhi's mind. The female in front of her was called Qingya. She was an underage female and had many protectors, all of whom were waiting for her to come of age and marry her.Among them was the leader Griffon, whom the original owner loved beyond measure.

The original person's friendship with Qingya was probably because of the leader's intention.

Qingya looked at Jiang Zhi, then at Cang Lin, and then at the pile of herbs and linen on the bed, her expression gradually became like she had seen a ghost.

"You, are you giving Cang Lin medicine?"

Jiang Zhi also froze.

No, you don’t knock on the door first when entering other people’s homes?

Oh, I got it instantly.

There is no door to her cave at all, just a straw curtain. Fortunately, no one else came in just by lifting the curtain before!

Jiang Zhi quickly retracted his hand and tied the linen cloth into a final knot.She didn't want to be OOC too suddenly, so she deliberately said to Qing Ya in an evil voice: "No, I'm applying poison to Cang Lin. When his wound becomes inflamed and fester, he will be in pain and beg me to pity him."

The kind-hearted young Qingya was shocked, but when she thought about what Jiang Zhi usually did, she felt it was reasonable.

The only thing that makes her feel unreasonable is:

"The leader's side..."

In her opinion, Jiang Zhi was so obsessed with the leader that she could blush for three days just by smelling his breath.

Not to mention being injured, even if the leader just came back from hunting and had his clothes a little torn, Jiang Zhi would feel so distressed.

Now she actually completely ignored the leader... and ruined Cang Lin in the house?

Seeing her expression, Jiang Zhi simply broke the jar and put on a "rare and strange" posture: "I don't want to go to the leader recently. I have to keep him cold for a few days to make him remember how good I am!"

Qing Ya really wants to say, after a few days of cold weather, the leader will forget about you!But looking at Jiang Zhi's expression, she decided to shut up even though she was underage but had a high emotional intelligence.

"Qingya, are you okay? Put down the curtain, the wind is blowing in." Jiang Zhi was afraid that he would make a mistake if he said more, so he immediately planned to see the guest off.

Qingya hesitated to speak, and finally could only say "Oh" mechanically, and hurriedly put down the curtain. Before leaving, she almost tripped over the stone at the door.

When the footsteps outside were far away, Jiang Zhi finally breathed a sigh of relief.
